page.overview:
What is Forbidden Acolytes?

The Forbidden Acolytes were an organization mentioned by the self-crowned king of Cloud City, Yathros Condorius the First when he was held back while attempting to confront Lando Calrissian, the Baron Administrator of the city. Condorius thought that the Forbidden Acolytes or the Invisible Cartel might have led Calrissian to surrender Cloud City to the Galactic Empire.
